source: Real ZXNAME0000XZ memory systems contain queues, banks, caches, coalescers, and many outstanding requests. The observed latency of a dependency changes with hit location, contention, and request concurrency, so one timeless “ZXNAME0001XZ latency” number is usually misleading.
zh: 真实的 ZXNAME0000XZ 内存系统包含队列、库、缓存、聚结器和许多未完成的请求。观察到的依赖项延迟会随着命中位置、争用和请求并发性而变化，因此一个永恒的“ZXNAME0001XZ 延迟”数字通常会产生误导。
